title: The Coronal Ejection Refuge
logline: A heliophysics researcher defects from an orbital observatory to warn an unprotected asteroid quarry that a suppressed solar storm will incinerate their barracks.

roles.description: Orbital solar physicist; panicked, exhausted, fleeing corporate security after stealing classified flare telemetry.
Head of an unshielded surface mining crew; skeptical, stubborn, unwilling to halt production for unverified warnings.
A fast corporate security pursuit craft sent to silence the researcher before the warning leaks.
An energy corporation operating orbital solar collectors and private heliophysics stations.
A shallow hollow beneath an unshielded asteroid quarry where sixty drillers sleep.
An automated observation platform in close solar orbit monitoring coronal mass ejections.

public_situation: Solar observatories declare space weather stable while {role:renegade_astronomer} docks at {role:quarry_bunker} pleading with miners to evacuate.
private_truth: {role:solar_consortium} concealed an imminent Class-X coronal mass ejection because an evacuation alert would trigger massive power grid insurance liabilities.

beats.public_change: Magnetometer warnings flicker red across outer station channels as solar wind density climbs unexpectedly.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to tap the observatory relay and extract the unredacted coronal telemetry logs before security wipes them.
missions.private_fact: He signed the falsified stability report yesterday before his conscience forced him to steal the true data.

beats.public_change: Auroral curtains engulf the asteroid belt as energetic proton flux begins frying unshielded comm relays.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver dense ferrite ore to encase the quarry bunker in magnetic shielding before the radiation shockwave hits.
missions.private_fact: The quarry foreman's corporate contract docks the crew three months' pay if they stop drilling without executive sign-off.

beats.public_change: A corporate pursuit vessel closes in on {role:quarry_bunker} with orders to confiscate the astronomer's telemetry drives.

missions.reason: Engage the corporate interceptor to keep the bunker docking hatch clear while miners shelter behind the ferrite berm.
missions.private_fact: The interceptor captain hails mid-fight offering fifty thousand credits to let the pursuit team seize the astronomer.

player_choice.prompt: With the interceptor disabled and the ferrite shield secured, the coronal front is ten minutes away. The pilot must choose how to deploy the proof.

options.label: Broadcast the unredacted flare telemetry across emergency system relays, saving regional crews and exposing the consortium
Sell the solar flare forecast to a rival plasma harvesting syndicate to fund permanent relocation for the miners
Surrender the drives to the consortium in exchange for private bunker berths and corporate immunity

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the flare data across all open system channels.
resolutions.summary: The emergency alert triggers a system-wide shutdown. The drillers survive behind the ferrite berm, while {role:solar_consortium} faces ruinous safety fines.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast a suppressed coronal forecast just ahead of the proton shockwave, saving an unshielded mining crew.

resolutions.reached_by: The telemetry is sold to private energy syndicates to fund worker evacuation.
resolutions.summary: Rival harvesters reap surplus solar plasma. The mining crew is bought out and relocated, while {role:solar_consortium} covers up its falsified logs.

resolutions.reached_by: The warning is suppressed or the pilot surrenders the drives.
resolutions.summary: The coronal mass ejection scours the unshielded quarry. The miners suffer severe radiation poisoning, and {role:solar_consortium} declares the storm an unforeseen anomaly.

loose_threads.detail: A private reinsurance rider covering solar power collector dropouts was executed two hours before the flare warning was suppressed.
The optical sensor package from the flare observatory had its threshold alarm values manually re-indexed by an administrator.
Spot prices for bulk magnetic shielding ferrite spiked forty percent across station exchanges this morning.

radio_hooks: Heliophysics bureau issues routine reassurance regarding solar wind stability across inner belts.
Asteroid drilling syndicates report widespread high-energy static across communications bands.
Energy brokers note sudden surges in short-term orbital battery reserve futures.

voice_direction.renegade_astronomer: Frantic, breathy, and stammering. Speaks in rapid bursts of technical figures and constantly looks over his shoulder.
voice_direction.quarry_foreman: Skeptical, gruff, and dismissive. Uses short, unyielding sentences and treats scientific warnings as management tricks to cut pay.

title: The Ion Storm Communion
logline: An orbital cathedral's annual pilgrimage fleet is trapped in an ion storm when the station's consecrated lightning spire is shattered, revealing its solid platinum core was secretly pawned.

roles.description: Presiding administrator of the orbital cathedral; pious, sweat-drenched, terrified his secret financial sins will kill his flock.
Coordinator of the pilgrimage flotilla; devout, unbending, demanding the cathedral light its holy protective beacon.
An armed ceremonial picket vessel maintaining the sanctuary perimeter against outer belt raiders.
The monastic religious order managing the orbital shrine and its lucrative pilgrimage concessions.
A magnificent spired orbital basilica with stained-glass solar baffles hanging in an ion cloud.
A chaotic station marketplace where scrap metal and counterfeit religious tokens are hawked.

public_situation: Pilgrim transport vessels huddle near {role:orbital_cathedral} as ion storm bolts crack the holy sanctuary's decorative spires.
private_truth: {role:penitent_deacon} pawned the cathedral's solid-platinum lightning arrestor to cover speculative bad debts, replacing it with gilded iron pipe.

beats.public_change: The cathedral bell chimes out of sequence as electrical surges flicker through the stained-glass docking ring.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver high-grade cuprite ore to wind emergency grounding coils for the cathedral's overloaded electrical relays.
missions.private_fact: He needs the ore to replace the conductive capacity lost when he unscrewed the original platinum rod.

beats.public_change: St. Elmo's fire engulfs pilgrim transports moored along the sanctuary docks as electrostatic potential peaks.

missions.reason: Scan the shattered spire telemetry to determine whether the gilded replacement pipe can withstand another direct surge.
missions.private_fact: The scan proves the pipe is already melting and will flash into shrapnel upon the next lightning strike.

beats.public_change: Desperate raiders attempt to breach the cathedral's outer reliquary while the pilgrim marshal demands an explanation.

missions.reason: Raiders shot down an automated service drone carrying a heavy inductive grounding transformer; recover the transformer pod.
missions.private_fact: He traded the original spire core to a scrap broker operating from the foundry bazaar three months ago.

missions.reason: Deliver the recovered transformer directly to the main spire scaffolding before the storm's core arrives.
missions.private_fact: He wrote a full confession and locked it in the vestry desk in case the lightning strikes him dead.

player_choice.prompt: The transformer is operational and grounds the cathedral. The deacon's fraud is known to the pilot, but the pilgrims believe a miracle occurred.

options.label: Present proof of the pawned spire to the pilgrim marshal, demanding the deacon face trial and restitution
Help the deacon consecrate the new transformer as a divine miracle to preserve the sanctuary's pilgrimage revenue
Compel the deacon to surrender cathedral gold reserves to establish an independent pilgrim insurance fund

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents proof of the pawned spire to the pilgrim assembly.
resolutions.summary: The truth is revealed. {role:penitent_deacon} is stripped of his robes and arrested for sacrilege, while {role:church_syndicate} faces immense public scandal.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an orbital cathedral's lightning rod was fake, toppling a corrupt deacon before the storm struck.

resolutions.reached_by: The replacement transformer is consecrated as a sign of divine favor.
resolutions.summary: The cathedral survives. {role:church_syndicate} declares a miracle, multiplying pilgrim tithes while {role:penitent_deacon} lives in terrified piety.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the deacon to endow a safety indemnity fund for the pilgrims.
resolutions.summary: A mutual relief endowment is established for the pilgrim flotilla. {role:penitent_deacon} remains in office under strict scrutiny, his bad debts liquidated.

resolutions.reached_by: The transformer is destroyed or the grounding attempt fails.
resolutions.summary: A massive ion discharge incinerates the spire. {role:orbital_cathedral} suffers catastrophic electrical fires, leaving {role:penitent_deacon} disgraced and ruined.

loose_threads.detail: A pawn receipt found in the foundry bazaar lists a four-hundred-kilo solid platinum lightning rod stamped with ecclesiastical seals.
Underwriters doubled premiums on passenger vessels docking at the orbital basilica three weeks before the festival.
A customs clearance bill at the foundry lists twenty meters of hollow iron conduit electroplated in gold leaf.

radio_hooks: Orbital basilica invites faithful to annual celestial ion communion as solar winds rise.
Station scrap traders report mysterious influx of high-purity ceremonial platinum bullion.
Meteorological bureau warns pilgrim flotillas of severe electrical discharges around orbital shrines.

voice_direction.penitent_deacon: Pious, trembling, and breathy. Alternates between ornate religious benedictions and desperate, panicked pleas for secular assistance.
voice_direction.pilgrim_marshal: Stern, solemn, and unbending. Speaks in measured liturgical cadences, utterly convinced of divine protection until sparks fly.

title: The Micrometeorite Drift Accord
logline: A dense micrometeorite stream threatens to shred a vital trading depot, but the station management consortium stalls deployment of deflection charges to void tenant leases.

roles.description: Station maintenance head; grime-streaked, blunt, furious that management is ignoring structural warnings to clear tenants.
Depot leasing superintendent; icy, immaculate, calculating insurance payouts against contract termination clauses.
The corporate conglomerate owning the trading depot and controlling dockside commercial leases.
The local union of independent shopkeepers, mechanics, and prospectors renting subsidized depot berths.
A bustling orbital trade station positioned directly in the path of a recurring micrometeorite debris stream.
A secure orbital bunker housing high-yield shaped kinetic charges used for asteroid clearing.

public_situation: Warning sirens wail at {role:drift_depot} as a high-density micrometeorite swarm approaches while deflection arrays sit inactive.
private_truth: {role:consortium_director} intentionally withheld deployment authorization for the kinetic deflection charges to condemn the depot and void rent-controlled tenant leases.

beats.public_change: Notice boards announce mandatory evacuation alerts as {role:consortium_director} declares the oncoming debris stream unavoidable.

missions.reason: Courier high-resolution orbital radar telemetry probes to the mechanic's shop before the consortium shuts down private sensor channels.
missions.private_fact: The mechanic has maintained the station for thirty years and knows the automated charges can easily disperse the swarm.

beats.public_change: Pings from micrometeorite impacts ring through the hull as the leading edge of the gravel storm punches through exterior radiator panels.

missions.reason: Scan the depot's central ordnance firing computer to prove the director deliberately disabled automated firing sequences.
missions.private_fact: The computer log contains a direct executive override command entered by the director forty-eight hours ago.

beats.public_change: Emergency pressure bulkheads seal off lower residential concourses as secondary rock fragments penetrate the docking ring.

missions.reason: Retrieve manual firing keys and high-explosive trigger caps from the orbital demolition bunker to bypass the locked computer.
missions.private_fact: The bunker security locks were sabotaged with civilian resin, suggesting an insider helped the director seal the charges.

beats.public_change: The main debris core is thirty minutes out as tenants scramble for escape shuttles and the director prepares to abandon station.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver heavy ferrite ballast to anchor the manual kinetic charge mounts against outer hull gales.
missions.private_fact: The director offered the mechanic a five-percent equity partnership in the rebuilt executive hub if he walks away.

player_choice.prompt: The manual charges are mounted and primed. The pilot holds evidence of the director's sabotage and the detonation key to save the depot.

options.label: Fire the kinetic charges to shatter the debris stream, saving the station and publicly exposing the director's fraud
Leverage the evidence to force the consortium to grant full ownership shares of the rebuilt station to the tenant union
Withhold the detonator in exchange for a substantial private salvage grant from the consortium

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot detonates the kinetic charges and exposes the director's sabotage.
resolutions.summary: The kinetic blast shatters the debris field. {role:drift_depot} is saved, {role:consortium_director} is ousted in disgrace, and tenant leases are preserved.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot bypassed locked corporate computers to blow apart a debris swarm and save a working-class station.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot uses the incriminating override logs to negotiate a cooperative lease covenant.
resolutions.summary: The debris is deflected under a compromise treaty. {role:miners_union} wins permanent equity shares in {role:drift_depot}, curbing corporate authority.

resolutions.reached_by: The charges fail to deploy or the pilot accepts the consortium payoff.
resolutions.summary: Micrometeorites scour {role:drift_depot}. The station is evacuated and condemned, allowing {role:station_consortium} to void all tenant leases and claim insurance.

loose_threads.detail: Recent tenant lease renewals included an expedited force majeure clause specifically referencing micrometeorite storm damage.
Inspection tags on the demolition cache charges show maintenance signatures for next month already stamped and approved.
Advance bonds for a high-end corporate replacement station were floated on capital exchanges two weeks before the debris warning.

radio_hooks: Orbital traffic controllers track dense micrometeorite stream converging on commercial depot lanes.
Station tenants union lodges formal protest over delayed activation of automated deflection batteries.
Industrial salvage brokers prepare heavy wrecking hulls for post-impact clearance operations.

voice_direction.chief_mechanic: Gruff, abrasive, and relentless. Speaks in short, angry imperatives, refusing all commercial euphemisms.
voice_direction.consortium_director: Silky, polite, and completely detached. Speaks in placid administrative jargon, treating catastrophic structural breach as a routine legal milestone.

title: The Magnetic Shear Convoys
logline: A catastrophic magnetic shear shuts down three systems' public jump lanes, sparking a fierce clash when a private cartel fakes safety data to funnel all shipping into their toll corridor.

roles.description: Leader of stranded civilian freight convoys; exhausted, unyielding, trying to keep dozens of independent haulers from starvation.
Chief negotiator for the private jump gate corridor; suave, predatory, demanding extortionate toll rates for safe transit.
A heavily armored patrol cruiser guarding the entrance to the cartel's shielded toll corridor.
The independent interstellar freight haulers union whose members are stranded across the sector.
A predatory logistics cartel holding monopoly rights over hardened, magnetic-shielded transit conduits.
A crowded orbital weigh-station where hundreds of haulers wait out the magnetic shear front.
A deep-space environmental sensor platform in an intermediate system monitoring field line turbulence.
The sector's main commercial jump nexus in a destination system where transit disputes are regulated.

public_situation: Three star systems face gridlock as {role:toll_syndicate} declares public jump routes closed due to dangerous magnetic shear turbulence.
private_truth: {role:cartel_syndic} altered calibration algorithms on {role:magnetospheric_buoy} to exaggerate shear levels and force all commercial freight through private pay-per-jump lanes.

beats.public_change: Public navigation beacons turn crimson as navigation authorities issue a regional transit embargo across public gates.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver high-purity cuprite ore to wind emergency magnetic deflection coils for stranded life-support haulers.
missions.private_fact: His convoy has only twelve days of fuel left before reactor chill sets in, leaving seventy ships frozen in the belt.

beats.public_change: The toll syndicate posts armed security around the private shielded gate, demanding forty percent cargo tariffs.

missions.reason: Retrieve raw environmental telemetry drives directly from the deep-space sensor buoy to verify if public lanes are truly impassable.
missions.private_fact: He suspects the cartel's automated warnings were issued six hours before the magnetic wave actually reached the sector.

beats.public_change: Telemetry scans reveal that the magnetic shear wave subsided forty-eight hours ago, leaving public lanes clear.

missions.reason: Scan the buoy's algorithmic processor to document that the cartel uploaded a persistent override loop faking turbulence.
missions.private_fact: The syndicate factor personally authorized the code upload from an encrypted brokerage terminal in the transit hub.

beats.public_change: The cartel's frigate establishes an interdiction perimeter around {role:regional_transit_hub} to prevent proof from reaching regulators.

missions.reason: Neutralize the cartel frigate blocking the orbital arbitration approach to clear a path to the regulator's bench.
missions.private_fact: The frigate captain hails mid-combat offering eighty thousand credits and a lifetime toll exemption if the pilot surrenders the drives.

missions.reason: Deliver the raw buoy drives and the hacked algorithm proof directly to the sector transit commission.
missions.private_fact: The marshal knows that even if the lanes reopen, independent haulers will need months to recoup their lost contracts.

player_choice.prompt: The proof is submitted and the cartel's armed picket is broken. The pilot faces three distinct proposals for settling the transit crisis.

options.label: Force immediate reopening of public jump routes and mandate heavy punitive reparations against the toll cartel
Negotiate a permanent toll exemption and revenue-sharing compact exclusively for the independent haulers union
Accept the cartel's buyout, concealing the falsified shear data to preserve private gate revenues

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot tables the buoy evidence, proving the shear was artificially fabricated.
resolutions.summary: Public jump routes are declared clear. {role:toll_syndicate} is hit with massive fines, and {role:convoy_marshal} leads his freighters safely home.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a predatory logistics cartel faked magnetic storm warnings to charge extortionate gate tolls.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an exclusive settlement granting the union permanent toll-free access.
resolutions.summary: The union wins free access to private conduits. {role:toll_syndicate} maintains tolls on outside haulers, while {role:haulers_union} secures commercial dominance.

resolutions.reached_by: The buoy evidence is suppressed or the pilot accepts the cartel bribe.
resolutions.summary: The public gates remain shuttered. {role:toll_syndicate} extracts crushing tolls, forcing independent haulers into bankruptcy and cementing cartel control.

loose_threads.detail: A maintenance data cartridge recovered from the buoy carries encryption hashes registered to the cartel factor's private terminal.
Forward toll coupons for private conduit access were traded at eighty percent premiums by an unlisted brokerage two days prior to the alert.
Public telemetry beacons show an unexplained four-hour transmission delay between raw sensor reception and public broadcasting.

radio_hooks: Transit commission declares regional jump lanes hazardous due to unprecedented magnetic shear front.
Independent freight convoys bottleneck at border checkpoints facing ruinous private passage tariffs.
Logistics cartel defends forty percent rate hikes, citing maintenance costs for hardened conduit loops.

voice_direction.convoy_marshal: Gravelly, exhausted, and stubborn. Speaks in blunt logistical terms and flatly refuses to indulge corporate double-talk.
voice_direction.cartel_syndic: Silky, patient, and patronizing. Uses polite euphemisms for financial extortion and feigns deep personal sympathy for stranded haulers.
